title: Quarterly Planning
agenda:
Budget approval
Launch timing
Accessibility review
transcriptSegments: The approved annual budget cap remains seven hundred fifty thousand dollars. Finance confirmed the current split fits under it.
We agreed to keep the existing cap and not request an increase this quarter.
For launch timing, August 15 gives QA a full final week. The team agreed to move the launch to August 15.
Priya will publish the revised rollout plan by Tuesday.
Separately, support will draft an escalation guide for the rollout.
